purpose: The one field of OPS's W-1 baseline that must change because the window-read manifest gained g09d. No other baseline field changes. This file is a proposal, not a baseline: the machines lane holds no baseline file (OPS assembles it at the window), so it is an edit, not a replacement.

edit.derivation: sha256 of the MANIFEST.sha256 file text (14 lines, g09d included); `sha256sum MANIFEST.sha256`. With the g09d line removed the text hashes to the current value.

also_required: Every capture sidecar must be produced by the runner while MANIFEST.sha256 is the 14-file one, so each meta file's manifest_sha256 equals the proposed value. A sidecar made under the 13-file manifest fails S0-14 ('captured under a different manifest'). Re-run any already captured file.
